# Parkinson's disease — motor drug therapy

> 8 concept packs from the research run on motor drug therapy (levodopa, dopamine agonists, MAO-B/COMT/A2A drugs, fluctuations, dyskinesia, gait and medication safety); 131 of the family's 1,155 claims are grouped under this section in llms-facts.txt. Educational research reference, not medical advice.
> Source: research run parkinsons-motor-drug-therapy · Generated: 2026-11-27 by llms-deep-optimizer v1.2.1 · Mode: family

## Concept packs

- [Run-level pack: Motor drug therapy](https://llmsx.org/tree/parkinson-s-disease-motor-drug-therapy-levodopa-dopamine-agonists-mao-b-comt-a2a-drugs-fluctuations-dyskinesia-gait-and-medication-safety/): Run-level pack covering levodopa, dopamine agonists, MAO-B/COMT/A2A drugs, fluctuations, dyskinesia, gait and medication safety
- [Amantadine, anticholinergics and other adjunct drugs](https://llmsx.org/tree/amantadine-anticholinergics-and-other-adjunct-drugs/): Older inconclusive amantadine reviews address different evidence from later formulation-specific trials
- [Dopamine agonists and apomorphine](https://llmsx.org/tree/dopamine-agonists-and-apomorphine/): The TOLEDO randomized trial supports infusion for persistent motor fluctuations, but adverse effects and treatment withdrawal remain relevant
- [Impulse control disorders and dopamine dysregulation](https://llmsx.org/tree/impulse-control-disorders-and-dopamine-dysregulation/): Specialist cognitive behavioural therapy may help persistent ICDs, but trial limitations and endpoint-dependent drug results argue against overstating treatment certainty
- [Levodopa and carbidopa formulations and delivery](https://llmsx.org/tree/levodopa-and-carbidopa-formulations-and-delivery/): RISE-PD supports IPX203 over immediate-release treatment in patients with fluctuations; it does not establish prevention of future motor complications
- [MAO-B, COMT inhibitors and adenosine A2A antagonists](https://llmsx.org/tree/mao-b-comt-inhibitors-and-adenosine-a2a-antagonists/): Safinamide and opicapone have supportive adjunct trials, while istradefylline evidence assessments differ between the MDS review and EMA’s refusal assessment
- [Motor fluctuations, wearing-off and dyskinesia management](https://llmsx.org/tree/motor-fluctuations-wearing-off-and-dyskinesia-management/): Wearing-off, delayed ON, sudden OFF and dose failure represent different patterns; peak-dose and diphasic dyskinesia also differ in their timing
- [PD medication timing, interactions and hospital safety](https://llmsx.org/tree/pd-medication-timing-interactions-and-hospital-safety/): Pharmacy recommendations address reconciliation, custom order times, alerts, medicine availability and careful substitution
- [Tremor, gait, freezing and postural instability management](https://llmsx.org/tree/tremor-gait-freezing-and-postural-instability-management/): Freezing must be assessed in relation to medication state: OFF, pseudo-ON and true ON freezing need different interpretations

## Top sources, live-checked 2026-11-27

- [nice.org.uk/guidance/ng71 (15 claims in this run)](https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng71/chapter/recommendations): NICE recommends specialist cognitive behavioural therapy directed at ICDs when changing dopaminergic treatment is ineffective
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7851275 (9 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7851275/): The motor-complications review describes no significant difference in motor-complication rates at 80 weeks in a trial comparing immediate levodopa initiation with a 40-week delay
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10199833 (6 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10199833/): COMT inhibition reduces levodopa conversion to 3-O-methyldopa and increases levodopa availability; it is an adjunct mechanism that depends on levodopa treatment
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10682362 (6 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10682362/): A pharmacy workflow review recommends treating levodopa as time-critical, documenting administration times and reasons for deviations, and using overdue alerts and custom order times
- [gocovrihcp.com/Gocovri_Digital_PI_MG.pdf (6 claims in this run)](https://www.gocovrihcp.com/Gocovri_Digital_PI_MG.pdf): The February 2026 Gocovri label warns against abrupt withdrawal because of worsening parkinsonism and neuropsychiatric symptoms
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8672433 (5 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8672433/): For early PD, the AAN review found greater motor improvement with initial levodopa than with initial dopamine agonists
- [dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/fda (4 claims in this run)](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/fda/fdaDrugXsl.cfm?setid=c4d65f28-983f-42b4-bb23-023ae0fe81b2): Safinamide inhibits MAO-B and thereby reduces dopamine catabolism; additional effects on glutamate release and sodium channels have been described
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10041452 (4 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10041452/): For residual tremor, anticholinergics have only a restricted role in young cognitively intact patients, propranolol has limited supporting evidence
